app.name: Agent Quest
app.tagline: Learn AI agent engineering by playing

home.pitch: 20 levels take you from a single model call to a production-grade agent. Every level is real code + automatic grading, and at the end you export the agent you wrote as a runnable Node project.

level.resetConfirm: Reset {{path}} to this level's starting code? Your changes to this file will be lost.
level.needKey: Configure an API key in Settings before running on a real model
level.borrowed: Reference solution (filled in because you skipped a level)

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: Switching reloads the page. Your code and progress are kept; code you already wrote stays in the language it was written in.
settings.remember: Remember the key on this device (localStorage, only in your browser)
settings.proxy: Route through a local proxy (works around CORS)
settings.proxyHelp: Run npm run proxy in the project directory to start it (listens on 127.0.0.1 only).
settings.freeMode: Free mode: unlock every level (skipped files are filled in from the reference solutions)
settings.resetConfirm: Delete all progress and code? This cannot be undone.
